description: Cases for the patterns of volatile entries. A pattern with `valid` false is not a pattern of this format (a format issue with the code `pattern`). Otherwise the whole of each string in `matches` must match and none of `rejects` may. Unless `native` is false, the regular expression engine of the language must agree when it is given the pattern wrapped as ^(?:pattern)$ without flags; that is how the packages show that their own matching is the ECMAScript one.
